evaluation.claim_scope: Published synthetic CERT subset, incident-associated copy user-days; no live or production-accuracy claim.

baseline.updates: Past observed days, including prior anomalies, enter history; labels never filter history.

model.weights_status: Predeclared demo engineering parameters, not learned probabilities.

rules.actor_metric_definition: Denominator includes all selected master actors with incidents overlapping test, even without observable or scoreable file-copy days. A hit requires an alert inside an incident-associated copy day.

isolation_forest.actor_metric_definition: Denominator includes all selected master actors with incidents overlapping test, even without observable or scoreable file-copy days. A hit requires an alert inside an incident-associated copy day.

combined.actor_metric_definition: Denominator includes all selected master actors with incidents overlapping test, even without observable or scoreable file-copy days. A hit requires an alert inside an incident-associated copy day.

limits: No real employees or live enterprise data are represented.
A daily model does not score a partial current day.
A dataset label describes a scenario, not an inferred human intent.
Low support and distribution shift require a separate pilot.
An alert-budget threshold controls candidate triage, never hard DLP enforcement.

Positive days associate a declared actor's observed file copies with the master incident interval; this coarse contextual label does not prove each copy malicious. Exact file-observable IDs are supplementary. Other channels are outside this benchmark.

dataset_selection.selection_rule: Lowest SHA256(subject_id), independent of labels and scores; zero max_users means all.
dataset_selection.population: Active removable-media-copy user-days only; no zero-filled calendar days.

incident_coverage.denominator_rule: All selected master incidents overlapping the test interval, including no-copy/no-score incidents. Those are misses in coverage-adjusted actor/episode recall.
